deliveredSummary: Management kept working capital targets within limits while aggressively scaling revenue. Most margin and store expansion guidance remains long-term and pending.

divergences.story: Management expresses strong long-term confidence in execution
divergences.numbers: Net profit declined YoY from Dec 2024 to Sep 2025 despite high revenue growth

bull: Revenue expanded significantly to Rs 24,138 crore in Sep 2026 quarter.
EBITDA margins improved steadily from 1.2% in Mar 2025 to 3.1% in Sep 2026.
Net working capital days kept below target at 14 days in Q1 FY27.
bear: Net profit volatility remains high, dropping from Rs 176 crore in Sep 2024 to Rs 25 crore in Jun 2025.
Borrowings increased to Rs 5,757 crore in Sep 2026 from Rs 749 crore in Mar 2024.
Cash conversion cycle moved into positive territory at 2 days in Mar 2026.
business: Eternal Limited operates an online food service platform offering food delivery, dining-out services, loyalty programs, and quick commerce services across multiple countries.
